meta.team: 2 backend or full-stack engineers, 1 frontend engineer, designer 50%, QA 50%, content and operations 50%, product owner

sprints.name: Foundations and discovery
sprints.goal: Legal counsel engaged, payout model signed off, owner access obtained, backend and web scaffolds running in CI
sprints.demo: Walk through green CI, health endpoints, signed prize table and counsel engagement letter
sprints.risks: Owner unavailable or slow to share data; counsel timeline longer than expected

sprints.name: Accounts
sprints.goal: A user can register with phone OTP, keep a session and set a PIN; design discovery validated with players
sprints.demo: Register on a phone with a real SMS in the sandbox, log out everywhere, lock the PIN
sprints.risks: SMS delivery reliability in Rwanda; abuse of OTP endpoint

sprints.name: Design system and ledger
sprints.goal: Design system v1 and auth screens usable; ledger service posts balanced, idempotent transactions
sprints.demo: Sign up in the UI, then show ledger entries produced by a test posting and the concurrency tests
sprints.risks: Ledger concurrency bugs; design delays blocking UI work

sprints.name: Wallet and staging
sprints.goal: Wallet shows balances and history from the ledger; provider interface exists; staging infrastructure live
sprints.demo: Open the wallet UI with seeded history; deploy to staging
sprints.risks: Terraform and cloud account setup delays

sprints.name: Deposits and limits
sprints.goal: Deposit works end to end with the MTN MoMo sandbox including webhooks and the sweeper; limits enforced
sprints.demo: Deposit in the sandbox, replay the webhook, watch the state machine
sprints.risks: MTN sandbox instability and onboarding documentation gaps

sprints.name: Question service and game config
sprints.goal: Deposit UI done; question service, game configuration and first question pool in place; staging deploys on merge
sprints.demo: Import questions from content/, show a versioned prize table, deploy by merge
sprints.risks: Question content quality and review throughput
sprints.capacityNote: New Year holidays: reduced capacity (about 80 percent)

sprints.name: Game engine and withdrawals
sprints.goal: Server-authoritative game runs through the API; entry selection screen done; withdrawal request flow with holds works
sprints.demo: Play a full game via API with timers and settlement; request a withdrawal and see the hold
sprints.risks: Settlement correctness under concurrency; timer fairness on slow networks

sprints.name: Play UI and admin auth
sprints.goal: A player can play 3 questions in the UI and see results; abandoned games recover; staff login with 2FA and audit
sprints.demo: Play on a 320 px phone, kill the connection mid-game and resume, log in to admin with TOTP
sprints.risks: Mobile network drops; UI performance on low-end Android
sprints.capacityNote: Heroes Day (1 February) falls in this sprint: reduced capacity

sprints.name: Payouts and admin tools
sprints.goal: MTN MoMo payouts complete in sandbox; staff manage users and questions; support can view user timelines
sprints.demo: Approve a sandbox payout, add 20 questions in the admin, open a dispute timeline

sprints.name: Finance and country gating
sprints.goal: Dual-control payout approvals, daily reconciliation, treasury caps and country gating protect funds and legality
sprints.demo: Inject a reconciliation mismatch and watch the alert and freeze; show a country with real money disabled
sprints.risks: Reconciliation against real provider statement formats

sprints.name: KYC and fraud
sprints.goal: KYC tiers, age enforcement and fraud flag queue operate; admin KPI dashboard live
sprints.demo: Complete KYC in sandbox, trigger a fraud flag and review it
sprints.risks: KYC provider coverage for Rwandan IDs; false-positive fraud flags

sprints.name: Responsible play and readiness
sprints.goal: Limits, self-exclusion and reality checks enforced; observability, load targets and abuse protection in place
sprints.demo: Self-exclude and try to play; show dashboards and the load test result
sprints.risks: Load test environment parity with production
sprints.capacityNote: Easter (late March) falls in this sprint: reduced capacity

sprints.name: Security and legal
sprints.goal: Pen test remediated, DR proven, notifications live, legal pages published after counsel review
sprints.demo: Show pen test report with zero critical or high findings, restore a backup, receive a win SMS
sprints.risks: Counsel review delays blocking legal pages; critical findings late in the sprint
sprints.capacityNote: Kwibuka commemoration period (from 7 April): reduced capacity

sprints.name: Beta preparation
sprints.goal: Existing IHUGURE users and balances migrated with proof, support tooling and onboarding polished, production merchant onboarding done
sprints.demo: Migrate a dry-run dataset and reconcile it to zero difference; raise and resolve a support ticket
sprints.risks: Unprovable legacy balances; merchant approval delays

sprints.name: Private beta
sprints.goal: Invited users play with real money under low caps; daily reconciliation ritual running; feedback loop closed
sprints.demo: Daily beta review: volumes, reconciliation, top issues
sprints.risks: Real-money incidents; beta feedback overwhelming capacity
sprints.capacityNote: Normal capacity; protect the beta fix budget

sprints.name: Launch
sprints.goal: Launch gate passed, production deploy proven, performance targets met, hypercare plan active
sprints.demo: Production release with approvals, smoke tests and rollback rehearsal
sprints.risks: Legal gate not cleared (launch slips; keep free-to-play mode); last-minute defects
sprints.capacityNote: Light commitment on purpose: buffer for launch issues
